'''Adventure''' is a [[music]] track that can be unlocked inside [[Varrock]] city walls, excluding the [[Grand Exchange]]. It also plays in the [[Phoenix Gang Hideout]] and in the basement of the [[Blue Moon Inn]]. Within this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing [[Garden (music track)|Garden]], [[Medieval]], and [[Spirit (music track)|Spirit]].

In Classic mode, this track plays in [[Varrock Palace]].
